question: Should this broad browser-preview issue remain the canonical tracker, or should the focused dashboard preview-widget issue take over once maintainers approve the security boundary?
rationale: The remaining work is not a mechanical bug fix: it crosses Control UI product scope, browser-state exposure, dashboard architecture, and operator action safety, and current main only has backend primitives plus a generic plugin-tab seam.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker, Build Focused Leaf
options.body: Use this issue for browser-preview security/product decisions while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101138 carries the first trusted preview-widget implementation after the dashboard substrate is accepted.

options.title: Promote Preview Widget As Canonical
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101138 the single canonical implementation issue and close this tracker after a maintainer explicitly confirms that scope transfer.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Preview
options.body: Leave the request open but pause implementation until the modular-dashboard stack and browser-preview security model are separately approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker, Build Focused Leaf
recommendation.body: Use this issue for browser-preview security/product decisions while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101138 carries the first trusted preview-widget implementation after the dashboard substrate is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest current routing signal from this issue's prior review plus the merged plugin-tab precedent this work would build on.
